name: Scott Wolchok
biography: is a graduate student studying computer security at the University of Michigan under Prof. J. Alex Halderman. He tends to do whatever involves problem solving and software and needs doing. His past work includes exploiting China's Green Dam censorware (nominated for the 2009 Pwnie Award for Mass Ownage), defeating the Vanish data privacy system by crawling BitTorrent DHTs, and developing firmware for demonstration attacks on India's electronic voting machines.
